-- intro: {{Infobox/Magic |image= Dante levitates Black Bull base.png  |title= Gravity Magic |kanji= 重力魔法 |romaji= Jūryoku Mahō |english= Gravity Magic (VIZ, Funimation)  |user= #Dante Zogratis #Lucifero #Lucius Zogratis #Moris Libardirt }} {{Nihongo|Gravity Magic|重力魔法|Jūryoku Mahō}} is a magic attribute that allows the user to manipulate gravity.
-- Description:
    This magic attribute allows the user to manipulate gravity at will. In order to use it to its full potential, specific spells are required, which are stored within grimoires.
    The user can decrease gravity, allowing them to make themselves and other things float. The user can also greatly increase the effects of gravity on the target, slamming them into the ground. Additionally, the user can u
    The user can also manipulate gravity on specific objects or body parts. By increasing the gravity on said object, it causes the attacks to deal more damage due to the added weight. By decreasing the gravity on said objec
    The user can also utilize gravity to warp space and generate miniature black holes.{{Clr}}
